If there is azurerm_network_security_rule.a.direction == Inbound, Then azurerm_network_security_rule.a.source_application_security_group_ids is null (i.e. it does not refer to azurerm_network_security_group.id)

If azurerm_network_security_rule.a.description is null or empty, Then azurerm_network_security_rule.a.source_application_security_group_ids is null (i.e. it does not refer to azurerm_network_security_group.id)

If there is azurerm_network_security_rule.a.access == Allow, Then azurerm_network_security_rule.a.source_application_security_group_ids is null (i.e. it does not refer to azurerm_network_security_group.id)
